posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 1h ago • World models like Sora ignore human beliefs and intentions, leading to inaccurate action predictions. • New Mental World Modeling framework incorporates mental variables like beliefs into AI simulations. • Weaker language models with mental variables outperform stronger models without this framework.
